A3: No exclusions — include all flagged items Q4: Do you want to categorize flagged items by the size of the month gap between Document Date and Posting Date? Cross-year differences are included (e.g., Jan-2025 vs Dec-2024 should be flagged). Rule 2: Apply the rule to all line items in FBL3N with no population filters (no restriction by account type, offset type, company code, cost/profit center, etc.). Rule 3: No exclusions apply. Include reversals, provisions/accruals, opening/closing or adjustment entries, and any other posting types if they meet the exception rule. Rule 4: Analyze all available rows in the file; no time window limits are applied. Rule 5: Evaluate and present exceptions at the line-item level. Do not aggregate by Document Number or by account. Rule 6: The comparison is based on month-year only. If Document Date and Posting Date fall in the same month-year, do not flag, regardless of the specific day. Rule 7: Only include flagged exceptions in the final output dataset. Non-flagged records are excluded from the output. Rule 8: No monetary threshold applies. Include all amounts, regardless of value. Rule 9: Provide a clear indicator and rationale on each output row: - Exception_Flag set to True (all output rows are exceptions) - Exception_Reason set to “Document month-year > Posting month-year” for consistent interpretation - Quarterly_Exception_Flag set to True if the Document Date quarter-year is later than the Posting Date quarter-year; otherwise False (computed for all output rows) - Quarterly_Exception_Reason set to “Document quarter-year > Posting quarter-year” when Quarterly_Exception_Flag is True; otherwise left blank Rule 10: Present amounts in the Local Currency as recorded; no currency translation or revaluation is performed as part of this analysis. Rule 11: Include key identification and context fields (e.g., Company Code, Document Number, G/L Account, narrative texts, organizational attributes, and user/time stamps) to facilitate review, investigation, and follow-up of each exception. Rule 12: In addition to the month-year exception, compute a separate quarterly exception indicator for context and analysis: determine quarter-year for Document Date and Posting Date (Q1–Q4 by calendar year). Set Quarterly_Exception_Flag = True when Document Date quarter-year > Posting Date quarter-year; otherwise False. Cross-year differences are included. Output Columns Company Code: Identifies the legal entity responsible for the transaction; needed to route findings to the correct entity. Document Number: Uniquely references the journal entry; essential for tracing back to source details and supporting documents. Document Type: Indicates the nature of the posting (e.g., vendor invoice, journal entry); helps assess posting intent. Posting Key: Shows debit/credit characteristics at the line level; useful for understanding entry mechanics. G/L Account: Specifies the account impacted; necessary to evaluate the financial statement area affected. G/L Acct Long Text: Descriptive account name; aids reviewers in quickly interpreting the account without cross-referencing charts. Document Date: The original document or invoice date; used in the period comparison to identify potential timing issues. Posting Date: The accounting date used to post the entry; compared against Document Date to detect later-period document dates. Amount in local currency: Monetary impact of the line item; quantifies exposure of each exception. Local Currency: Currency of the amount; clarifies valuation basis for the amount shown. Text: Line item narrative; provides context and potential explanations for timing differences. Document Header Text: Header-level narrative; additional context that may indicate reasons for timing (e.g., cut-off, adjustments). Offsett.account type: Type of counterparty (e.g., vendor, customer, G/L); helps understand the nature of the offset. Offsetting acct no.: Identifier of the counterparty account; supports follow-up with specific vendors/customers/accounts. Cost Center: Organizational attribution for costs; assists in contacting responsible teams and assessing impact by function. Profit Center: Profitability dimension; supports analysis of where exceptions affect segment reporting. Reference: Reference string from the document; aids in linking to source documents or processes. Entry Date: Date the entry was entered into the system; useful for assessing timing relative to posting and document dates. User Name: User who posted the entry; enables accountability and follow-up on exceptions. Exception_Flag: True/False indicator of exception status; in this output it will always be True, making exception status explicit. Exception_Reason: Standardized reason text (“Document month-year > Posting month-year”); ensures consistent understanding of why the item was flagged. Quarterly_Exception_Flag: True/False indicator showing whether the Document Date quarter-year is later than the Posting Date quarter-year; provided for quarterly cut-off analysis alongside the month-based exception population. Quarterly_Exception_Reason: Standardized reason text (“Document quarter-year > Posting quarter-year”) populated when Quarterly_Exception_Flag is True; blank otherwise.

# ============================================================================
# PART 1: IMPORT LIBRARIES & FILE PATH VARIABLES
# ============================================================================

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import os
import ira

fbl3n_path = "/Users/ajay/Documents/workflow_builder_v4/data/uploads/fd00bc81-5de1-44be-b03f-229308356465/FBL3N.csv"
output_file_path = "/Users/ajay/Documents/workflow_builder_v4/data/outputs/Expenses_document_date_for_later_period_v/s_posting_date_in_previous_period_/_qtr/output_b2d7c4d8-4e28-42bc-a767-859432041214.csv"

# ============================================================================
# PART 2: LOAD DATAFRAMES & IRA PREPROCESSING
# ============================================================================

# Column categories for FBL3N
DATE_COLS_FBLSN = [
    'Document Date',
    'Posting Date',
    'Entry Date'
]
SAME_COLS_FBLSN = [
    'Company Code', 'Document Number', 'Document Type', 'Posting Key',
    'G/L Account', 'G/L Acct Long Text', 'Text', 'Document Header Text',
    'Offsett.account type', 'Offsetting acct no.', 'Cost Center', 'Profit Center',
    'Reference', 'User Name'
]
UPPER_COLS_FBLSN = ['Local Currency']
LOWER_COLS_FBLSN = []
TITLE_COLS_FBLSN = []
NUMERIC_COLS_FBLSN = ['Amount in local currency']

# Load FBL3N data
df_fbl3n = pd.read_csv(fbl3n_path, low_memory=False)
print(f"✓ Loaded {len(df_fbl3n):,} rows from FBL3N")

# Verify required columns
required_columns_fbl3n = (
    DATE_COLS_FBLSN + SAME_COLS_FBLSN + UPPER_COLS_FBLSN + LOWER_COLS_FBLSN + TITLE_COLS_FBLSN + NUMERIC_COLS_FBLSN
)
missing_columns = [col for col in required_columns_fbl3n if col not in df_fbl3n.columns]
if missing_columns:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing columns in FBL3N: {missing_columns}")

# IRA preprocessing for FBL3N
for col in DATE_COLS_FBLSN:
    if col in df_fbl3n.columns:
        df_fbl3n[col] = ira.convert_date_column(df_fbl3n[col])

if SAME_COLS_FBLSN:
    df_fbl3n = ira.clean_strings_batch(df_fbl3n, SAME_COLS_FBLSN, rules={
        "remove_excel_artifacts": True, "normalize_whitespace": True, "case_mode": "same"})

if UPPER_COLS_FBLSN:
    df_fbl3n = ira.clean_strings_batch(df_fbl3n, UPPER_COLS_FBLSN, rules={
        "remove_excel_artifacts": True, "normalize_whitespace": True, "case_mode": "upper"})

if TITLE_COLS_FBLSN:
    df_fbl3n = ira.clean_strings_batch(df_fbl3n, TITLE_COLS_FBLSN, rules={
        "remove_excel_artifacts": True, "normalize_whitespace": True, "case_mode": "title"})

if NUMERIC_COLS_FBLSN:
    df_fbl3n = ira.clean_numeric_batch(df_fbl3n, NUMERIC_COLS_FBLSN)

print(f"✓ IRA preprocessing complete for FBL3N")

# ============================================================================
# PART 3: BUSINESS LOGIC
# ============================================================================

# Rule: Flag when Document Date month-year > Posting Date month-year (cross-year allowed)
# Build comparable month keys (YYYY*12 + MM)
doc_month_key = (df_fbl3n['Document Date'].dt.year * 12 + df_fbl3n['Document Date'].dt.month)
post_month_key = (df_fbl3n['Posting Date'].dt.year * 12 + df_fbl3n['Posting Date'].dt.month)
exception_flag = doc_month_key > post_month_key

# Filter to only exceptions at line level
result_df = df_fbl3n[exception_flag].copy()
print(f"✓ Applied month-year exception filter: {len(result_df):,} rows flagged")

# Add Exception_Flag and Reason (all rows in result are exceptions)
result_df['Exception_Flag'] = True
result_df['Exception_Reason'] = "Document month-year > Posting month-year"

# Compute Quarterly Exception Flag: Document quarter-year > Posting quarter-year
# Quarter key (YYYY*4 + Q)
doc_quarter_key = (result_df['Document Date'].dt.year * 4 + result_df['Document Date'].dt.quarter)
post_quarter_key = (result_df['Posting Date'].dt.year * 4 + result_df['Posting Date'].dt.quarter)
result_df['Quarterly_Exception_Flag'] = doc_quarter_key > post_quarter_key

# Quarterly reason only when quarterly flag is True
quarter_reason = "Document quarter-year > Posting quarter-year"
result_df['Quarterly_Exception_Reason'] = ""
result_df.loc[result_df['Quarterly_Exception_Flag'] == True, 'Quarterly_Exception_Reason'] = quarter_reason
print("✓ Computed quarterly exception indicators")

# Select and order output columns as specified
output_columns = [
    'Company Code', 'Document Number', 'Document Type', 'Posting Key',
    'G/L Account', 'G/L Acct Long Text', 'Document Date', 'Posting Date',
    'Amount in local currency', 'Local Currency', 'Text', 'Document Header Text',
    'Offsett.account type', 'Offsetting acct no.', 'Cost Center', 'Profit Center',
    'Reference', 'Entry Date', 'User Name',
    'Exception_Flag', 'Exception_Reason', 'Quarterly_Exception_Flag', 'Quarterly_Exception_Reason'
]

# Ensure all output columns exist before finalizing
missing_output_cols = [c for c in output_columns if c not in result_df.columns]
if missing_output_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing expected output columns: {missing_output_cols}")

result_df = result_df[output_columns]

if len(result_df) == 0:
    print("⚠ Warning: Result dataframe is empty! No exceptions found based on the rule.")

print(f"✓ Final result: {len(result_df):,} rows, {len(result_df.columns)} columns")

# Ensure output directory exists
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_file_path), exist_ok=True)

# Save output
result_df.to_csv(output_file_path, index=False)
print(f"✓ SUCCESS: Saved results to {output_file_path}")
